name: UK Data Protection Act Overlay
description:
Regime overlay for the UK Data Protection Act 2018 / UK-GDPR. Carries no membership of its own — it contributes overrides on top of whatever the selected theme policies resolve.

What it enforces: an NHS number is health data, which UK-GDPR Article 9 classes as a special category requiring a higher condition for processing; it is elevated to critical rather than treated as an ordinary national identifier.

Pair with: the pii and healthcare themes, and a configuration whose region lens includes UK.

Scope: UK DPA / UK-GDPR — overrides only

overrides.reason: NHS numbers are special category data under UK-GDPR Article 9
